name: Tenant leak or restricted disclosure
signal: Confirmed or credible unauthorized retrieval, including titles/search/AI context
action: Hold affected scope; preserve safe evidence; security/privacy incident escalation
resume: Negative suite, impact review, remediation and fresh acceptance

name: Unauthorized official or financial write
signal: Mutation outside actor, source-system or institution authority
action: Kill new writeback; checkpoint commands; reconcile committed/uncertain outcomes
resume: Source reconciliation and domain-authorized correction; fresh write authority

name: Corruption or reconciliation failure
signal: Integrity failure or unexplained divergence from authoritative source
action: Hold writes; isolate repair/restore; preserve audit and queues
resume: DB/object checksums, external-state reconciliation, post-backup change review

name: Withdrawn or expired authority
signal: Applicable approval withdrawn, expired or scope-mismatched
action: Hold only affected operation/cohort; prevent fallback expansion
resume: New current exact-scope approval; gate-negative retest

name: AI policy or gateway bypass
signal: Direct/proxy/worker route evades policy, budget, source access or kill
action: Hold relevant AI dispatch; preserve permitted audit; settle reservations

name: Identity disclosure
signal: Pseudonym/private identity exposed outside accepted disclosure scope
action: Hold affected surface; privacy-safe transition; no name-reveal fallback
resume: Privacy impact acceptance, corrected visibility and regression evidence

name: Missing support, alerts or backup
signal: Required coverage unavailable or alert delivery/acknowledgement fails
action: Hold activation/expansion; preserve urgent authorized handoff
resume: Named coverage and successful operated alert/support drill

name: Accepted service threshold breached
action: Hold affected feature; diagnose against exact agreed metric/window
resume: Recovered accepted operating window and fresh release review
